one_line: AI faces environmental scrutiny, new data-sharing rules, industry deals, and heightened safety concerns.

themes.title: Arizona AI data centers face pushback
themes.text: State lawmakers and officials in Arizona are opposing new AI data center projects, citing long‑term water depletion and recent drought, even as earlier chip fabs were approved.

stories.headline: Bipartisan opposition rises to AI data centers in drought‑stricken Arizona

themes.title: India releases trusted data sharing handbook
themes.text: India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology published a handbook on the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture, outlining a techno‑legal framework that lets institutions share data for AI training while retaining control through contracts, clean rooms and privacy safeguards.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training

themes.title: AI industry sees big deals
themes.text: Guidewire announced a $1.7 billion cash acquisition of AI underwriting firm Hyperexponential, Core 4 Solutions listed a 300‑rack Nvidia A100 supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million, Deepgram bought Daily to keep its Pipecat voice AI framework open source, and OpenAI lowered its fundraising target to $20 billion while maintaining a $1.25 trillion valuation.

stories.headline: Guidewire to acquire Hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash
Core 4 Solutions lists decommissioned Nvidia A100 supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million
Deepgram acquires Daily, keeping open‑source Pipecat framework intact
OpenAI cuts funding target to $20 billion, valuation stays at $1.25 trillion

themes.title: Safety incidents drive new AI defenses
themes.text: The VOLTA‑AUTODOXER malware sends victim data to large language models to rank assets, Anthropic added a rule blocking AI‑generated video‑game clones, and OpenAI patched an HTML preview exploit that allowed attackers to hijack ChatGPT accounts.

stories.headline: Volta‑Autodoxer malware uses LLMs to rank victims by monetizable assets
Anthropic adds rule to block AI-generated video game clones
OpenAI patches HTML preview exploit that let attackers hijack ChatGPT accounts
